name: gitlatex-collab
description: Optional realtime collaboration relay for GitLaTeX: a Cloudflare Worker with one Durable Object per room.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Your owner password for this relay. In GitLaTeX, **Live collaboration → Host** uses it to create a room for each project; the relay then generates that room's own token for you to share with co-authors. Choose a long random string (e.g. from a password manager) and keep it to yourself.
